acceptance: Delimited output is SHA-256 identical to bundled dbgen (trailing delimiter removed) for all 8 tables at SF 0.01, 0.1, 1 and 10, at 1 thread and default threads.
Parquet bytes are identical at 1, 4 and default threads on macOS arm64 and Linux x86_64; schema matches benchbox/core/tpch/schema.py through ArrowTypeMapper.
N=3 medians meet the ADR budget: SF 1 <= 3 s delimited / <= 4 s Parquet, SF 10 <= 30 s / <= 40 s, RSS <= 1,536 MiB (SF 1) and <= 2,048 MiB (SF 10).
context: Owner decisions 2026-11-26 (dialog): (1) PyPI: owner sets up Trusted Publishing once; the agent then tags and publishes 0.x releases when a stage merges and BenchBox needs it. (2) Library repo merges require the review bot (theseus review-verdict/review-gate) and essential CI, mirroring BenchBox. (3) SSB and synthetic acceptance by pre-approved objective criteria: exact row counts, zero orphan FKs, per-column null rate, distinct ratio and mean/quantiles within the legacy generator's 5-seed variation, every query returns rows on both engines where legacy did, exact DuckDB/DataFusion agreement; escalate only on failure. (4) Upstream gaps: implement in benchbox-datagen-core on upstream's public API; upstream PRs are contributions, never waited on; no vendoring. (5) Agent may open tpcgen-rs issues/PRs from the BenchBox-dev fork. (6) Add a Windows arm64 wheel; if it passes the gates, Windows arm64 cuts over too. (7) Cutovers pre-approved when every ADR gate passes; misses go to the owner. (8) Parquet corpus re-baseline once, after the TPC cutover, against library Parquet. (9) Retirement: after all cutovers plus one minor release, remove dbgen/dsdgen and legacy Python generators (qgen/dsqgen under adversarial review). (10) Feature batches: A library TPC; B BenchBox integration; C SSB + 8 synthetic in parallel; D cutovers + re-baseline; E Parquet semantics + DuckLake convert in parallel with A; F retirement.
description:
TPC-H stage of the library (docs/internal/adr/adr-benchbox-datagen.md (revised 2026-11-26, PR #4540), decisions 1, 3 and 5). Depend on tpchgen and tpchgen-arrow by exact version. Write delimited rows without the trailing delimiter and Parquet with BenchBox Arrow types, 122,880-row row groups, non-nullable NOT NULL columns and writer identity benchbox-datagen-<major>. Expose both entry points from the PyO3 module.

Guardrails: no fork of tpcgen-rs; no auto backend mode or silent fallback; Python stays the only manifest writer; heavy measurements only through make heavy-run with N=3 medians recorded in the PR body; budgets from the ADR table are the gate, and a miss goes to the owner rather than being waived.
